day_line: A fertile field on a Rooster day. Patient and precise: good for tidy work and careful plans, easy to nitpick.

lines.Yang Wood: Careful money moves today. Set a December budget before the sales start.
lines.Yin Wood: A neat chance pops up today. Say yes, then ask what it really involves.
lines.Yang Fire: Your ideas sparkle today. Share one in the group chat; skip the essay.
lines.Yin Fire: You're in a cheerful mood today. Put one small decoration on your desk.
lines.Yang Earth: Someone wants the same slot today. Swap it graciously; it pays back later.
lines.Yin Earth: Your friends feel close today. Plan the year-end makan and pick the date now.
lines.Yang Metal: Help comes easily today. Ask the colleague who knows; it saves an hour.
lines.Yin Metal: A sharp thought arrives today. Sleep on it before you send the reply.
lines.Yang Water: Your effort gets noticed today. Say thank you, and ask what's next.
lines.Yin Water: Tuesday feels a little heavy. Clear one small task first; the big one gets easier.
